'''Podono''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Podono commented on the merits of [[Castaan Staad armor]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
